title: 雅思·政府与社会精选 · 64 句
description: 围绕本主题练习论点、理由、条件、让步与政策评价；中英对照及逐题讲解，难度 3–5。

items.zh: 公共服务是否有效，不能只用办理了多少份申请来衡量。
items.en: The effectiveness of public services cannot be measured solely by the number of applications processed.
answers: The effectiveness of public services cannot be measured solely by the number of applications processed.
items.notes: 被动语态突出评价对象；processed 是过去分词定语，修饰 applications。

items.zh: 虽然普遍补贴容易实施，它也会把资金分配给并不需要帮助的家庭。
items.en: Although universal subsidies are easy to administer, they also direct funds to households that do not need assistance.
answers: Although universal subsidies are easy to administer, they also direct funds to households that do not need assistance.
items.notes: although 承认实施优势；direct funds to 表示将资金分配给。

items.zh: 如果申请福利的手续过于复杂，最需要帮助的人反而可能被排除在外。
items.en: If benefit applications are too complicated, those most in need may end up being excluded.
answers: If benefit applications are too complicated, those most in need may end up being excluded.
items.notes: those most in need 指最需要帮助的人；end up being done 表示最终遭遇某种结果。

items.zh: 与其只在选举期间征求意见，地方政府不如建立持续的公众咨询渠道。
items.en: Rather than seek views only during elections, local governments should establish ongoing channels for public consultation.
answers: Rather than seek views only during elections, local governments should establish ongoing channels for public consultation.
items.notes: rather than seek 与 should establish 平行；ongoing 强调持续进行。

items.zh: 人们更愿意遵守那些制定过程公开、执行方式一致的规则。
items.en: People are more willing to follow rules that are made transparently and enforced consistently.
answers: People are more willing to follow rules that are made transparently and enforced consistently.
items.notes: that 从句中两个被动谓语共用 are；transparently 与 consistently 分别修饰不同过程。

items.zh: 一项政策即使提高了平均收入，也可能让某些群体的处境恶化。
items.en: A policy may leave some groups worse off even if it raises average incomes.
answers: A policy may leave some groups worse off even if it raises average incomes.
items.notes: leave + 宾语 + 形容词；worse off 指经济状况更差。

items.zh: 为新移民提供语言课程，有助于他们获取服务和参与社区生活。
items.en: Offering language classes to new migrants can help them access services and take part in community life.
answers: Offering language classes to new migrants can help them access services and take part in community life.
items.notes: help 后并列 access 与 take part；access 在此是及物动词。

items.zh: 只有申诉得到独立审查时，公众才有理由相信处理过程是公正的。
items.en: Only when complaints are reviewed independently does the public have reason to trust the fairness of the process.
answers: Only when complaints are reviewed independently does the public have reason to trust the fairness of the process.
items.notes: only when 前置引起 does 倒装；have reason to do 表示有理由做某事。

items.zh: 为照顾家人而离开职场的人，不应因此失去重新就业的机会。
items.en: People who leave work to care for relatives should not thereby lose the opportunity to return to employment.
answers: People who leave work to care for relatives should not thereby lose the opportunity to return to employment.
items.notes: who 从句界定群体；thereby 表示因此，连接照护与就业处境。

items.zh: 法律可以禁止歧视，但改变日常偏见通常还需要教育和接触。
items.en: Legislation can prohibit discrimination, but changing everyday prejudices usually also requires education and contact.
answers: Legislation can prohibit discrimination, but changing everyday prejudices usually also requires education and contact.
items.notes: 转折区分法律作用与社会变化；changing ... 是单数动名词主语。

items.zh: 由于公共预算有限，每一项新支出都意味着可能放弃其他用途。
items.en: Because public budgets are limited, every new spending commitment may come at the expense of another use of funds.
answers: Because public budgets are limited, every new spending commitment may come at the expense of another use of funds.
items.notes: come at the expense of 表示以牺牲某事为代价；may 避免把取舍绝对化。

items.zh: 真正需要解决的是住房不稳定的原因，而不仅是街头可见的无家可归现象。
items.en: What needs to be addressed is the cause of housing insecurity, not just the visible presence of homelessness on the streets.
answers: What needs to be addressed is the cause of housing insecurity, not just the visible presence of homelessness on the streets.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；address a cause 表示处理成因。

items.zh: 如果志愿者承担了全部照护工作，服务的连续性就可能无法保证。
items.en: Were volunteers to provide all care services, continuity of care could become difficult to guarantee.
answers: Were volunteers to provide all care services, continuity of care could become difficult to guarantee.
items.notes: were + 主语 + to do 是省略 if 的假设条件句；continuity 指连续性。

items.zh: 图书馆既提供学习资源，也为没有其他去处的人提供公共空间。
items.en: Libraries provide both learning resources and public space for people who have nowhere else to go.
answers: Libraries provide both learning resources and public space for people who have nowhere else to go.
items.notes: both A and B 并列宾语；nowhere else to go 表示没有其他地方可去。

items.zh: 一个社会如何对待弱势群体，比单纯的经济总量更能反映其优先事项。
items.en: How a society treats vulnerable groups reveals more about its priorities than the size of its economy alone.
answers: How a society treats vulnerable groups reveals more about its priorities than the size of its economy alone.
items.notes: how 从句作主语；reveal ... about ... 表示揭示某方面信息。

items.zh: 即便处罚加重，如果违法行为很少被发现，威慑作用也可能有限。
items.en: Even when penalties become harsher, their deterrent effect may be limited if offences are rarely detected.
answers: Even when penalties become harsher, their deterrent effect may be limited if offences are rarely detected.
items.notes: even when 与 if 分别引出让步情境和限制条件；deterrent effect 指威慑作用。

items.zh: 公开政府合同，可以让公众更容易发现潜在的利益冲突。
items.en: Publishing government contracts can make potential conflicts of interest easier for the public to identify.
answers: Publishing government contracts can make potential conflicts of interest easier for the public to identify.
items.notes: make + 宾语 + 形容词；conflict of interest 表示利益冲突。

items.zh: 养老金制度必须兼顾退休者的生活保障和在职人口的负担。
items.en: Pension systems must balance financial security for retirees against the burden on the working population.
answers: Pension systems must balance financial security for retirees against the burden on the working population.
items.notes: balance A against B 表示权衡双方；不把其中一方的需要视为唯一目标。

items.zh: 无论申请者居住在哪里，基本服务的获取都应有最低标准。
items.en: Wherever applicants live, there should be a minimum standard of access to essential services.
answers: Wherever applicants live, there should be a minimum standard of access to essential services.
items.notes: wherever 引导让步从句；there should be 提出制度要求。

items.zh: 咨询会安排在工作日白天，这使许多全职工作者难以参加。
items.en: Consultation meetings are scheduled during weekday working hours, which makes attendance difficult for many full-time workers.
answers: Consultation meetings are scheduled during weekday working hours, which makes attendance difficult for many full-time workers.
items.notes: which 指代前一整件事；make + 宾语 + 形容词说明后果。

items.zh: 倘若政策制定者事先听取了租户意见，一些执行上的漏洞本可以更早发现。
items.en: Some implementation gaps could have been identified earlier if policymakers had consulted tenants in advance.
answers: Some implementation gaps could have been identified earlier if policymakers had consulted tenants in advance.
items.notes: could have been identified 搭配过去完成时条件从句，表达过去未实现的可能性。

items.zh: 与短期捐款相比，稳定的运营资金更有助于社区组织长期提供服务。
items.en: Stable operating funds are more likely than one-off donations to help community organisations provide lasting services.
answers: Stable operating funds are more likely than one-off donations to help community organisations provide lasting services.
items.notes: be more likely than ... to do 比较可能性；one-off 表示一次性的。

items.zh: 当政策依赖居民自行上网申请时，政府也应为无法上网的人提供帮助。
items.en: When a policy relies on residents applying online themselves, the government should also assist those who cannot get online.
answers: When a policy relies on residents applying online themselves, the government should also assist those who cannot get online.
items.notes: rely on 后接动名词结构；those who 指具有特定困难的人。

items.zh: 公众意见可以影响政策；不过，决策者仍需说明他们如何权衡不同诉求。
items.en: Public opinion can influence policy; nevertheless, decision makers still need to explain how competing interests were weighed.
answers: Public opinion can influence policy; nevertheless, decision makers still need to explain how competing interests were weighed.
items.notes: nevertheless 是连接副词，前面用分号；weigh interests 表示权衡利益诉求。

items.zh: 地方报纸停刊后，社区可能失去持续监督当地事务的渠道。
items.en: When a local newspaper closes, a community may lose a regular source of scrutiny of local affairs.
answers: When a local newspaper closes, a community may lose a regular source of scrutiny of local affairs.
items.notes: scrutiny of：对某事的仔细审查。

items.zh: 新闻报道应区分已核实的事实和仍有争议的解释。
items.en: News reporting should distinguish verified facts from interpretations that remain disputed.
answers: News reporting should distinguish verified facts from interpretations that remain disputed.
items.notes: distinguish A from B：区分两类信息。

items.zh: 公众获得信息的权利，需要与当事人的合理隐私需求相协调。
items.en: The public's right to information needs to be reconciled with individuals' reasonable expectations of privacy.
answers: The public's right to information needs to be reconciled with individuals' reasonable expectations of privacy.
items.notes: reconcile A with B：使两方面协调。

items.zh: 当娱乐新闻占据主要版面时，复杂的政策议题可能得到更少关注。
items.en: Complex policy issues may receive less attention when entertainment stories dominate the headlines.
answers: Complex policy issues may receive less attention when entertainment stories dominate the headlines.
items.notes: dominate：占据主要位置。

items.zh: 如果采访只选择最激烈的声音，公众可能误判多数人的态度。
items.en: Interviews featuring only the most extreme voices may distort perceptions of majority opinion.
answers: Interviews featuring only the most extreme voices may distort perceptions of majority opinion.
items.notes: distort perceptions of：扭曲对某事的认识。

items.zh: 公共广播需要稳定的资助，同时也需要独立于资助者的编辑判断。
items.en: Public broadcasting needs stable funding together with editorial judgement independent of its funders.
answers: Public broadcasting needs stable funding together with editorial judgement independent of its funders.
items.notes: independent of：独立于。

items.zh: 艺术资助不能只看观众人数，否则小众文化可能长期得不到支持。
items.en: Arts funding cannot rely on audience numbers alone, or minority cultural traditions may remain unsupported.
answers: Arts funding cannot rely on audience numbers alone, or minority cultural traditions may remain unsupported.
Arts funding can't rely on audience numbers alone, or minority cultural traditions may remain unsupported.
items.notes: or 表示否则会产生的后果。

items.zh: 免费开放博物馆可以降低门槛，但交通和开放时间也会影响参与。
items.en: Free museum entry can lower barriers, although transport and opening hours also shape participation.
answers: Free museum entry can lower barriers, although transport and opening hours also shape participation.
items.notes: shape 作动词表示影响形成。

items.zh: 传统工艺若只能作为廉价纪念品出售，手艺人的收入可能不足以维持传承。
items.en: When traditional crafts are sold only as cheap souvenirs, makers may earn too little to sustain their skills.
answers: When traditional crafts are sold only as cheap souvenirs, makers may earn too little to sustain their skills.
items.notes: too little to do：不足以支持某事。

items.zh: 城市举办大型节庆时，应考虑居民的日常生活是否受到过度干扰。
items.en: Cities hosting major festivals should consider whether residents' daily lives are excessively disrupted.
answers: Cities hosting major festivals should consider whether residents' daily lives are excessively disrupted.
items.notes: hosting 是修饰 cities 的分词。

items.zh: 旅游收入增加，并不保证当地居民能够负担不断上涨的住房成本。
items.en: Growth in tourism revenue does not ensure that local residents can afford rising housing costs.
answers: Growth in tourism revenue does not ensure that local residents can afford rising housing costs.
Growth in tourism revenue doesn't ensure that local residents can afford rising housing costs.
items.notes: ensure that：确保某情况成立。

items.zh: 将游客分散到不同季节，可能比不断提高旺季接待能力更可持续。
items.en: Spreading visits across seasons may be more sustainable than continually expanding peak-season capacity.
answers: Spreading visits across seasons may be more sustainable than continually expanding peak-season capacity.
items.notes: across seasons：跨不同季节。

items.zh: 犯罪减少的原因可能有很多，不能把所有变化都归功于一次政策调整。
items.en: Crime can fall for many reasons, so not every change should be attributed to a single policy adjustment.
answers: Crime can fall for many reasons, so not every change should be attributed to a single policy adjustment.
items.notes: attribute A to B：把 A 归因于 B。

items.zh: 对初犯者提供就业支持，可能有助于他们在服刑后重新融入社会。
items.en: Employment support for first-time offenders may help them reintegrate into society after serving a sentence.
answers: Employment support for first-time offenders may help them reintegrate into society after serving a sentence.
items.notes: serve a sentence：服刑。

items.zh: 监禁虽然能够暂时隔离危险人员，却不一定解决导致犯罪的社会条件。
items.en: Imprisonment can temporarily isolate dangerous individuals without necessarily addressing the social conditions behind crime.
answers: Imprisonment can temporarily isolate dangerous individuals without necessarily addressing the social conditions behind crime.
items.notes: without necessarily doing：未必能做到。

items.zh: 社区服务处罚需要适当监督，才能兼顾公共利益和公平执行。
items.en: Community service sentences require proper supervision to benefit the public and be applied fairly.
answers: Community service sentences require proper supervision to benefit the public and be applied fairly.
items.notes: 不定式中主动与被动分别表达目的。

items.zh: 如果前科记录永远阻碍求职，重新犯罪的风险可能更难降低。
items.en: Reducing reoffending may become harder if criminal records permanently block access to employment.
answers: Reducing reoffending may become harder if criminal records permanently block access to employment.
items.notes: block access to：阻碍获得机会。

items.zh: 支持犯罪受害者应包括情绪照护，而不仅是协助提供证词。
items.en: Support for crime victims should include emotional care, not simply assistance with giving testimony.
answers: Support for crime victims should include emotional care, not simply assistance with giving testimony.
items.notes: assistance with doing：协助做某事。

items.zh: 法律援助让收入有限的人也有机会理解和维护自己的权利。
items.en: Legal aid gives people with limited incomes an opportunity to understand and defend their rights.
answers: Legal aid gives people with limited incomes an opportunity to understand and defend their rights.
items.notes: give sb an opportunity to do。

items.zh: 程序公开并不意味着每个人都能理解复杂的法律措辞。
items.en: Open proceedings do not necessarily make complex legal language understandable to everyone.
answers: Open proceedings do not necessarily make complex legal language understandable to everyone.
Open proceedings don't necessarily make complex legal language understandable to everyone.
items.notes: make + 宾语 + 形容词。

items.zh: 社区体育设施应服务普通居民，而不只是培养少数精英运动员。
items.en: Community sports facilities should serve ordinary residents rather than focus solely on producing elite athletes.
answers: Community sports facilities should serve ordinary residents rather than focus solely on producing elite athletes.
items.notes: rather than 对照服务目标。

items.zh: 举办国际赛事可能提升城市知名度，但闲置场馆也会带来长期费用。
items.en: Hosting international events may raise a city's profile, but unused venues can create lasting costs.
answers: Hosting international events may raise a city's profile, but unused venues can create lasting costs.
items.notes: raise a profile：提高知名度。

items.zh: 女性参与体育的机会可能受到安全、费用和照护责任的共同影响。
items.en: Women's opportunities to take part in sport may be shaped by safety, cost and caring responsibilities together.
answers: Women's opportunities to take part in sport may be shaped by safety, cost and caring responsibilities together.
items.notes: be shaped by：受到共同影响。

items.zh: 年龄不应成为判断一个人是否能够继续贡献社会的唯一依据。
items.en: Age should not be the sole basis for judging whether someone can continue contributing to society.
answers: Age should not be the sole basis for judging whether someone can continue contributing to society.
items.notes: the basis for doing：作某判断的依据。

items.zh: 老年人独居不一定意味着孤独，但社区联系可以提供重要支持。
items.en: Living alone in later life does not necessarily mean loneliness, though community ties can provide valuable support.
answers: Living alone in later life does not necessarily mean loneliness, though community ties can provide valuable support.
Living alone in later life doesn't necessarily mean loneliness, though community ties can provide valuable support.
items.notes: though 补充另一层观点。

items.zh: 代际活动可以让年轻人与老年人通过共同任务建立联系。
items.en: Intergenerational activities can connect younger and older people through shared tasks.
answers: Intergenerational activities can connect younger and older people through shared tasks.
items.notes: through 表示实现联系的途径。

items.zh: 出生率下降会改变公共服务需求，但不同地区的变化速度可能不同。
items.en: Falling birth rates alter demand for public services, yet the pace of change may differ across regions.
answers: Falling birth rates alter demand for public services, yet the pace of change may differ across regions.
items.notes: the pace of change：变化速度。

items.zh: 托育服务的开放时间若不适合轮班家庭，就难以真正支持他们就业。
items.en: Childcare hours that do not suit shift-working families may do little to support their employment.
answers: Childcare hours that do not suit shift-working families may do little to support their employment.
Childcare hours that don't suit shift-working families may do little to support their employment.
items.notes: do little to do：对实现目标帮助不大。

items.zh: 以家庭为单位计算福利，可能忽略家庭内部资源分配不均的问题。
items.en: Calculating benefits at household level may overlook unequal access to resources within families.
answers: Calculating benefits at household level may overlook unequal access to resources within families.
items.notes: at household level：在家庭层面。

items.zh: 无偿照护工作虽然不直接产生工资，却支撑了许多有偿工作的开展。
items.en: Unpaid care supports much paid employment despite generating no wages directly.
answers: Unpaid care supports much paid employment despite generating no wages directly.
items.notes: despite 后接动名词。

items.zh: 捐赠的数量并不能完全说明一个慈善项目是否改善了受助者的生活。
items.en: The volume of donations does not fully show whether a charity project improves recipients' lives.
answers: The volume of donations does not fully show whether a charity project improves recipients' lives.
The volume of donations doesn't fully show whether a charity project improves recipients' lives.
items.notes: whether 从句表达待评估结果。

items.zh: 让受助者参与项目设计，可以减少资助内容与实际需求之间的差距。
items.en: Involving recipients in project design can narrow the gap between funding priorities and practical needs.
answers: Involving recipients in project design can narrow the gap between funding priorities and practical needs.
items.notes: involve sb in；narrow the gap。

items.zh: 灾后捐款需要透明的分配标准，以免偏远社区被忽略。
items.en: Post-disaster donations need transparent allocation criteria so that remote communities are not overlooked.
answers: Post-disaster donations need transparent allocation criteria so that remote communities are not overlooked.
Post-disaster donations need transparent allocation criteria so that remote communities aren't overlooked.
items.notes: so that 表示想实现的保障目标。

items.zh: 社会信任建立得慢，却可能因几次未被解释的失误而迅速受损。
items.en: Social trust develops slowly but can be damaged rapidly by a few unexplained failures.
answers: Social trust develops slowly but can be damaged rapidly by a few unexplained failures.
items.notes: unexplained：未得到解释的。

items.zh: 居民不愿参与咨询，可能是因为过去的意见从未得到回应。
items.en: Residents may avoid consultations because their previous suggestions have never received a response.
answers: Residents may avoid consultations because their previous suggestions have never received a response.
items.notes: because 解释参与意愿的来源。

items.zh: 公民教育需要展示如何参与公共事务，而不只是要求记住制度名称。
items.en: Civic education needs to demonstrate participation in public affairs rather than merely require memorisation of institutional names.
answers: Civic education needs to demonstrate participation in public affairs rather than merely require memorisation of institutional names.
items.notes: rather than 连接两种教育任务。

items.zh: 把所有服务都集中在大城市，可能加剧小城镇的人口流失。
items.en: Concentrating services in major cities may accelerate population loss in smaller towns.
answers: Concentrating services in major cities may accelerate population loss in smaller towns.
items.notes: concentrate A in B：把资源集中于某处。

items.zh: 移民政策既影响劳动力供给，也影响家庭能否长期生活在一起。
items.en: Migration policy affects labour supply as well as families' ability to live together over time.
answers: Migration policy affects labour supply as well as families' ability to live together over time.
items.notes: ability to do：实现某事的能力或机会。

items.zh: 社会融合不要求每个人放弃原有文化，却需要共同认可的基本规则。
items.en: Social integration need not require everyone to abandon their culture, but it does require shared basic rules.
answers: Social integration need not require everyone to abandon their culture, but it does require shared basic rules.
Social integration needn't require everyone to abandon their culture, but it does require shared basic rules.
items.notes: need not 表示不必；does 用于强调。

items.zh: 一个制度是否公平，也应看普通人能否理解它并提出异议。
items.en: A system's fairness should also be judged by whether ordinary people can understand and challenge it.
answers: A system's fairness should also be judged by whether ordinary people can understand and challenge it.
items.notes: by whether 引出评价依据。
